customManagers.description: Image tag AND helm chart version variables in base-config/cluster-patch, annotated with '# renovate: datasource=... depName=... [registryUrl=...]' on the preceding line. The registryUrl form is required for datasource=helm (chart versions): without a manager here Renovate's native flux manager cannot see a version that lives in a substitution variable, and the chart silently stops being updated - that is how k8s-monitoring drifted a whole major behind.
